Q4: A fleet of ships with red flags (British) arrives in the bay (27 Jan 1780, and again later). It looks like a relief convoy. Not completely sure.

Later, in the 1970s and 80s, the area fills with buildings and trees, and the border town grows. I'm not sure exactly what happens at the gate.
Q8: The runway and a crossing. In 2026 there are people walking on a street and across the airstrip/crosswalk at the border. The two built-up towns face each other across the open runway, with people crossing on foot between them. It looks like daily commuter traffic.
